verdict.rationale: Session encryption is a fair axis for a remote-access product, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of TeamViewer's session encryption or its protocol. Community posts only question whether end-to-end encryption exists between connected computers; that is skepticism, not evidence either way. With no documented capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sessions are encrypted end to end with the protocol documented, not just asserted
